{{Quote|Another ex-Intelligence agent, eh? Welcome to the military.|Trage|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Trage''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]]. He was stationed on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] where he participated in the [[Battle of Corellia]]. Following the dissolution of the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] he also welcomed [[Cipher Nine]] into the military ranks.
